scope: Day One from opening flight through the post-boss room-restoration celebration
production_rule: Every dirty room has two separate movies: entry/discovery before play and restoration/relationship payoff after play. Every Grok generation job is one shot with one camera move and two to four approved references.

movies.start_state: Pearl plane in flight before Sky Lagoon is revealed
movies.end_state: Roshan and Daddy see Sky Lagoon and prepare to land

movies.title: Lagoon Landing and Castle Approach
movies.start_state: Pearl plane has landed at the Sky Lagoon dock
movies.end_state: Roshan and Daddy reach the closed Pearl Castle doors

movies.title: First Dirty Castle Discovery
movies.start_state: Roshan and Daddy open the Pearl Castle doors
movies.end_state: The dirty Main Hall and the first glowing bathroom route are understood

movies.title: Bubble Bathroom — Dirty Entry
movies.start_state: Roshan crosses from the Main Hall into the dirty bathroom
movies.end_state: The dirty tub, dirty sink, trapped swimmer, and cleanup tools are readable

movies.title: Bubble Bathroom — Restored
movies.start_state: The final scrub is in contact with the last dirty surface
movies.end_state: The room is clean, the swimmer is safe, and Roshan looks toward the pool route

movies.end_state: The trash, algae, stopped waterfall, and sick seahorse are understood

movies.end_state: Waterfall and seahorse purify the giant pool; Rumi rises, thanks Roshan, and hugs her
